narrative_purpose: Makes the dense carbon-rich atmosphere mechanism legible at leaf scale: a Pandoran leaf can admit abundant carbon dioxide through a narrowly opened stoma while losing less water than an Earth leaf opened wide for the same carbon supply.
subject: Two matched leaf-surface cutaways viewed at the same scale. On the left, an Earth leaf has two kidney-shaped guard cells pulled far apart around a wide stomatal pore; only a sparse handful of carbon-dioxide molecules enter while a broad plume of water vapour escapes. On the right, a blue-green Pandoran leaf has its guard cells only slightly parted; a dense cluster of carbon-dioxide molecules enters through the narrow slit while only a thin wisp of water vapour leaves. Beneath both pores, moist mesophyll chambers and branching veins are visible.
scene: A paired botanical specimen plate suspended against a dark atmospheric field, with the Earth half in ordinary humid air and the Pandora half in visibly denser teal haze; the two leaves are aligned for direct comparison without baked-in symbols.
camera: Matched macro cutaways from directly above each epidermis, tilted just enough to reveal the air chambers beneath the pores.
light: Soft cyan transmitted light through both leaves; the Pandoran air carries deeper teal haze; escaping water catches pale mist highlights while incoming carbon is marked by sparse amber molecular spheres.
palette: Cool indigo and teal dominate, with pale mist for water vapour and restrained amber only on the carbon-dioxide molecules.
style: Painterly comparative botanical plate, precise enough to distinguish guard cells, pore width, mesophyll and gas movement while retaining natural material texture.
detail_level: High detail at both stomata; molecules are simplified physical spheres without letters; background and deeper tissue soften rapidly.
composition: Equal left and right leaf windows separated by a narrow band of darkness. Earth pore wide on the left with a large upward water plume; Pandora pore narrow on the right with a dense inward carbon cluster and small water plume. Preserve empty dark space above each pore framed by deep negative space.
consistency_notes: Both panels must show the same stomatal anatomy and scale; the teaching difference is pore width plus the relative density of incoming carbon and outgoing water, not a different organ.
negative_prompt: no text, no CO2 lettering, no labels, no arrows, no cartoon faces, no infographic chrome, no photographic or CGI look, no vector diagram
